active_objective.quest_name: Brief with Hookclaw and Enter the Vault
active_objective.description: Talk with Zikza Hookclaw and the two Hookclaw companions at the vault approach.
active_objective.next_step: Talk with Zikza, Skritch, and Pikkik at ltba-vault-entry before moving into the vault.

quest_context.quest_name: Brief with Hookclaw and Enter the Vault

current_objectives.description: Talk with Zikza Hookclaw and the two Hookclaw companions at the vault approach.
current_objectives.next_step: Talk with Zikza, Skritch, and Pikkik at ltba-vault-entry before moving into the vault.

current_objectives.description: Enter the vault after the Hookclaw briefing is complete.
current_objectives.next_step: Enter the vault interior from ltba-vault-entry after talking to the Hookclaw team.

current_objectives.description: Search the tomb and recover the magical hedge trimmer.
current_objectives.next_step: Search ltba-tomb-hazard-room for ltba-magical-hedge-trimmer and pick it up.

current_objectives.description: Return to Grandmother and hand over the recovered hedge trimmer.
current_objectives.next_step: Travel back to ltba-grandmas-house-parlor and turn in the hedge trimmer to Grandmother.

current_objectives.description: Speak with Grandmother, accept her request, and get sent to the tomb vault team.
current_objectives.next_step: Travel to ltba-grandmas-house-parlor, speak with Grandmother, and accept the Hookclaw vault assignment.

current_objectives.description: Question Gribbles about current whisper traffic.
current_objectives.next_step: Speak with Gribbles and gather a rumor lead chain.

current_objectives.description: Trace where the contraband route leaves the tavern district.
current_objectives.next_step: Travel to Absalom Streets and verify the suspected route.

current_objectives.description: Report the identified route to Eldric.
current_objectives.next_step: Return to Eldric and provide the route details.

current_objectives.description: Search the tavern for the hidden ledger cache.
current_objectives.next_step: Inspect the tavern and identify where the ledger was stashed.

current_objectives.description: Recover the concealed blackmail ledger.
current_objectives.next_step: Retrieve the blackmail ledger from the discovered cache.

current_objectives.description: Return the ledger to Gribbles.
current_objectives.next_step: Hand the recovered ledger to Gribbles.

current_objectives.description: Collect three resonance samples from the tavern.
current_objectives.next_step: Search the tavern and collect 3 resonance samples.

current_objectives.description: Work with Marta to stabilize the codex resonance.
current_objectives.next_step: Bring the samples to Marta and complete the stabilization ritual.

current_objectives.description: Find and recover Lost Spellbook in The Gilded Tankard
current_objectives.next_step: Search The Gilded Tankard and recover Lost Spellbook.

current_objectives.description: Return the books to the scholar
current_objectives.next_step: Speak to Marta the Scholar in The Gilded Tankard after collecting the Lost Spellbook.

quest_context.quest_name: Gather Torch Materials for the Tavern

current_objectives.description: Gather Torch Materials scattered around the tavern
current_objectives.next_step: Search the tavern common room and pick up each Torch Materials quest item.

current_objectives.description: Bring the torch components to the tavern keeper
current_objectives.next_step: Speak to the tavern keeper after collecting the torch components.

quest_context.quest_name: Collect Wine Bottles from the Tavern

current_objectives.description: Collect Wine Bottles from around the tavern
current_objectives.next_step: Search the tavern common room and pick up each Wine Bottles quest item.

current_objectives.description: Return the wine to the tavern keeper
current_objectives.next_step: Speak to the tavern keeper after collecting the wine.

quest_context.quest_name: Gather Storyline Leads in the Tavern

current_objectives.description: Speak to Eldric and gather his storyline lead.
current_objectives.next_step: Talk to Eldric in The Gilded Tankard and ask what work or danger he knows about.

current_objectives.description: Speak to Marta the Scholar and gather her storyline lead.
current_objectives.next_step: Talk to Marta the Scholar in The Gilded Tankard and ask what problem needs help.
